Job Title: Senior Backend Engineer
Company: CloudScale Inc.

About the Role:
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to design and scale high-throughput API microservices.

Requirements:
- 5+ years of experience with Python and backend frameworks (FastAPI, Django).
- Extensive hands-on experience with PostgreSQL database optimization and Redis caching.
- Deep expertise in AWS cloud services (S3, ECS, Lambda) and Kubernetes container orchestration.
- Proven track record leading technical teams and optimizing system latency.

Nice to Have:
- Experience with Kafka or event-driven streaming.
- Infrastructure as code expertise using Terraform.
